observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 15, 2026): the isolation check is effective and stays normative. In every lab cell where a disk shared with another instance covered the proof directory (a host directory hot-plugged at it, a custom volume, the same through a profile, a disk at /run, a volume shared by a VM and unprivileged and privileged containers), the other instance wrote a file that the files API reported as uid 0 and mode 0600 in A, i.e. a forged proof; the check, run on expanded_devices, rejected every such cell on 5.21 and 6.9, and it MUST use expanded_devices (a profile device shows only there). A host directory present at boot was hidden by the guest tmpfs on /run, which is not to be relied on; the check rejects it too. The check is tightened to reject any non-root disk device whose path overlaps the proof directory, at, above or below it. No other device type needs to be forbidden; nested LXD stays out of scope. Evidence: runs 20261013T202307Z-g-l12-*.
